## Checklist

## For a legal-content change

<!-- Delete this section if the change touches no jurisdiction material. -->

- [ ] Every rule cites at least one declared source
- [ ] `published_from` and `effective_from` are both set, and are distinguished
- [ ] `certainty` states a level and a reason
- [ ] `review.status` is justified — no unsourced rule promoted to a verified status
- [ ] Test cases included: positive, negative, boundary date, missing fact
- [ ] Competing interpretations recorded rather than resolved by preference
